json.title: Pink Peak Dawn
json.logline: A young man wakes in Gangtok to witness the Himalayan mountains turning glowing pink in early sunrise.

palette: soft sage green in distant foliage
character_rules: one protagonist appears in every scene with the same face, hair length and build
wardrobe is identical from the first scene to the last
the face stays readable in at least three-quarter profile
style_bible.lighting: cinematic low-angle golden-hour light with gentle halation and soft falloff
style_bible.medium: loose gouache painting with visible brush strokes and softly blended colour

events.visual: Soft dim room opening onto misty morning skyline
Transition from quiet room frame to wide mountain panorama
Golden dawn light catches snow edges on distant peaks
The entire Himalayan range bursts into glowing radiant pink
Multi-layered brushstroke memory visual of pink summits
Soft warm light envelops the young man as music slows
Final warm rose glow fades softly to soft light

scenes.camera_note: Slow gentle push toward the cold window pane
scenes.action: A young man with short dark curly hair, rectangular black-rimmed glasses, slim build, and light brown skin tone wearing a dark wool coat and yellow scarf gazes softly out a frosty window frame.
scenes.setting: Inside a dim wooden Gangtok hotel room in winter dawn

scenes.camera_note: Slow horizontal drift across mountain landscape
scenes.action: The young man stands silently on a wooden balcony facing cold dark Himalayan ridges.
scenes.setting: A Gangtok balcony overlooking misty blue mountain valleys before dawn

scenes.camera_note: Tilt up along frozen balcony wood to rising sky
scenes.action: Frost crystals melt into glinting water droplets along an ornate carved wooden railing.
scenes.setting: Detailed wooden balcony edge overlooking hazy valley depths

scenes.camera_note: Fast subtle push toward subject's expectant face
scenes.action: The young man rests his hands on the wooden railing while looking up in wonder.
scenes.setting: Gangtok rooftop terrace with dark mountain silhouettes against glowing horizon

scenes.camera_note: Majestic wide pull revealing full illuminated mountain range
scenes.action: The young man watches massive snow-capped peaks illuminate in glowing rose pink sunlight.
scenes.setting: Panoramic vista of distant snow peaks glowing vibrant pink under sunrise sky

scenes.camera_note: Multi-plane drift combining dynamic mountain textures
scenes.action: The young man stands amid soft floating painterly layers of pink mountain slopes.
scenes.setting: Dreamy layered landscape of sunrise mountain ridges and prayer flags

scenes.camera_note: Slow pull back as warmth settles across the frame
scenes.action: The young man smiles quietly with closed eyes as golden morning light bathes his face.
scenes.setting: Sunlit balcony corner with warm ambient haze
